---
name: federation-branch-capability
description: Upgrade a federation branch by matching capability gaps to vetted reusable skills, assigning them within the hierarchy, and measuring whether the branch actually improves. Use by Top or Senior agents when a branch lacks a required capability.
---

# Federation Branch Capability

1. Identify the branch task and missing capability.
2. Check whether an existing federation member already covers the gap.
3. If not, invoke federation-skill-discovery.
4. Route every external candidate through federation-skill-intake.
5. Assign an approved skill only inside the agent's existing authority scope.
6. Define a bounded trial task and measurable acceptance check.
7. Compare performance before and after the skill.
8. Promote a skill to branch-default only after evidence of improvement.
9. Preserve provenance and rollback instructions.
10. Share a successful skill upward for federation-wide review; do not silently propagate it to sibling branches.

Top agents may curate capabilities for their own branch, but skill installation never grants constitutional rank, membership, credentials, or broader authority.
